primary: Frozen direct T controls throughout the 0.32s interval and afterwards.
alternate: Highest neural score in a different jump/dash/downward-cast class among currently feasible alternatives. Use that complete native key at onset; for the remainder of 0.32s retain its horizontal and jump-hold intent, allowing fresh jump/dash/cast pulses only when also requested by T. Then resume T.
risk_trigger: Top training quartile of a frozen risk readout on T features; 0.72s prediction of a native HP loss; vulnerable trio only.
fit: Cross-fit ridge outcome regressions by training fight. Fit one conservative linear contrast on the frozen T representation to choose between the two exact options. Same schedule, neural readouts and option decoder in the executable.
screen: On six held fights require positive fight-mean four-second observed reward and positive in at least four fights against T; estimated lost native masks lower, eight-second measured reward nonnegative. No learned continuation in either outcome. Report terminal counts separately.
